author: reek
body: Zero-player tic-tac-toe. Both seats play the full-depth minimax search, and two exhaustive sweeps prove the perfection claim empirically: with the AI fixed in one seat and the opponent playing every possible line, the AI never loses a single game, in either seat. Self-play always ends in a draw.

author: reek
body: Walk the complete game tree with the AI fixed in one seat: at the AI's turn it plays its chosen move, at the opponent's turn every legal reply is explored. Every terminal position is tallied.
